capabilities: Lock whole notes in place as ciphertext
Seal inline blocks and selected text as sn1 fragments
Unlock with password, TOTP code or recovery key
Re-lock unlocked notes on a configurable policy
Decrypt notes offline with a standalone HTML tool
extras: Ships a dependency-free tools/decrypt.html for offline decryption; keeps the last 5 ciphertext generations in a backups/ folder; notes must be decrypted before uninstalling; while a note is unlocked its plaintext is indexed and synced.
problem: Encrypting a few sensitive notes usually means a separate vault or sidecar files, and a forgotten password means the data is gone for good.

relations.evidence: Works with Obsidian Sync, Remotely Save, Git and similar sync schemes.

summary: Encrypts chosen notes and inline blocks in place, unlocking with a password, TOTP code or recovery key while the ciphertext stays in the note body.
